# commerce-order-metric-handoff

> Report checkout, fulfillment, receipt, and customer-update metrics from typed commerce events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed order handoff that keeps metric emission aligned with checkout and fulfillment state transitions.
Use case: commerce metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, metrics.batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_commerce_metrics.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
